description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about refunds after a cancellation or long delay.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about refunds after a cancellation or long delay, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "When Skyway cancels a flight or delays its departure 3 hours or more"; "refund the unused fare to the original form of payment, whatever the cause"; "seat and bag fees on that flight go back with the fare"; "a passenger who flew, on the original or a replacement flight, gets no refund". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
